results.name: generated call IDs are stable-format and unique
titles are trimmed, length-capped and defaulted
one save writes one record holding both track Blobs and shared timing
stored timing is a copy, not a live reference to capture state
microphone-only capture is clearly marked and owns one track
stopping with no audio saves nothing and writes nothing
an inconsistent record (mic-only timing with two tracks) is refused
a quota failure rejects the save and leaves zero records
rename changes only the title and keeps both track Blobs
delete removes only the chosen record and leaves the other intact
metadata export comes from the stored record and contains no Blob
